# Compatibility

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask compatibility` from the conformance corpus; do not edit by hand. -->

The QuakeC codebases of the conformance corpus (`corpus/manifest.toml`), and how each fares
with QuakeC Studio's compiler (COMP-9). **Build** is each module compiled with `qc-codegen`,
in the dialect the codebase's `quakec.toml` declares, or with none id's 1.01 in the
vanilla dialect and every other codebase in the FTEQCC dialect. **Behaviour**
is whether the nightly compiler differential runs our program and the reference compiler's
(id's qcc for 1.01, the pinned FTEQCC otherwise) on the same calls in the VM and finds them
the same, with at least 90% of the statements reached (DIFF-12.5). The release workflow
regenerates this list on every release; `corpus/compatibility.toml` records the known gaps.

| Codebase | License | Build | Behaviour | Issues |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
